text:
His homeland could fail great Osuna, but his deeds not its defense; the Spains gave death and prison to him who made fortune their slave.


His envies wept; foreign nations with his own: Flanders' fields are his tomb, the bloody moon his epitaph.


At his funeral Parthenope lit Vesuvius, Trinacria Mongibello; martial weeping swelled to flood.


Mars gave him heaven's best place; Meuse, Rhine, Tagus, and Danube murmur grief.

translation.title: His Homeland Could Fail Great Osuna...
